title: Crew of Wellington Bomber LN482
memorial_details: Restored propeller blade, bent in places, supported by a flat-topped pyramid-styled square wooden base. Names of crew engraved onto a board-mounted brass plaque fixed to the lower propeller blade. New Zealand and Union flags stand outwards to either side of the propeller.
inscription: Upper propeller blade : In memory of / the 6 crew members / of / Wellington Bomber 482 / of 11 OTU / Which crashed near the Church / 5th April 1944 Plaque attached to lower propeller blade : (6 NAMES) / LEST WE FORGET
